summary: Frontend-only test (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390) of bank matching rules (RegoleDialog, MatchDialog 'save as rule'), Riconciliazione rule labels, Previsione di cassa page and the Dashboard bank-panel forecast link, on the main agent's TEST_Cassa Srl. I added 2 TEST_ movements (INTERESSI PASSIVI TRIMESTRE -3.20, STIPENDIO DICEMBRE -1500). Everything requested works. One real layout bug: the Regole dialog overflows horizontally at 390px. There are also some minor UX and label issues.

minor.issue: When a rule has no note, it writes match.label as 'regola <nome>'. The UI then appends ' · regola "<nome>"', so the row shows 'Spese e commissioni bancarie · regola Spese · regola "Spese"'. Use an empty note by default, or skip the UI suffix when the label already names the rule.

The new rule is not applied to other matching movements right away. STIPENDIO DICEMBRE stayed 'da riconciliare' until /banca/auto ran (a later rule save or the Riconcilia automaticamente button). RegoleDialog save runs /banca/auto; MatchDialog does not.

ui_bugs.issue: The dialog content is wider than the viewport: the title, the right edges of the inputs, the importo max field, some category chips and the rule-row text are cut off. Root cause: DialogContent is a CSS grid with an implicit auto column, and the 'truncate' (nowrap) rule description forces that column to max-content. Fix: add 'grid-cols-1' or '[&>*]:min-w-0' to the DialogContent className, or 'min-w-0' to the rule list wrapper.

issues: The YAxis tickFormatter Math.round(v/1000)+'k' gives duplicate, misleading ticks for small balances: 1k, 1k, 0k, 0k, 0k for a range of -185 to 1220. Use compact formatting with decimals, or plain euros when |v| < 10000.

A file account with no balance (saldo null, shown as '—') counts as 0 without any warning. KPI says '1 conti' and Saldo totale says 0,00 €, so the forecast looks reliable but is not. Show a note when some accounts have no saldo.
Grammar: '1 conti', '1 movimenti riconciliati', '1 movimenti da riconciliare corrispondono', 'applicata 1 volte'. Use singular forms.
The 'Includi le scadenze già passate (da oggi)' label is ambiguous.

design_issues.issue_note: After editing a rule, the toast 'Regola salvata · N movimenti riconciliati' counts every rule applied by /banca/auto, not only the edited one (seen: editing a disabled rule reported 1 reconciled, which was done by a different rule).
issues: The toast count can be misleading.

passed_tests: rules-btn opens rules-dialog; rule-new-btn shows rule-form; rule-save-btn is disabled until nome, contiene (2+ chars) and categoria are set
rule-segno chips, rule-min/max inputs, rule-cat-0..6 (7 categories) and rule-note-input all work
rule-test-btn -> rule-prova-result '1 movimenti da riconciliare corrispondono' with a matching example
rule-save-btn -> toast 'Regola salvata · 1 movimenti riconciliati'; rule-row appears with 'applicata 1 volte'; the movement moved to Riconciliati with tx-match containing 'regola "TEST_Interessi"'
rule-toggle switches checked/unchecked and persists; rule-edit prefills (nome, max=100) and saves the rename; rule-delete (after confirm) removes the row

MatchDialog: match-tab-altro, match-tab-cat-1, match-save-rule-checkbox; match-rule-text-input prefilled 'stipendio novembre'; save is disabled with 1 char; save -> toasts 'Movimento riconciliato' + 'Regola salvata: ...'; the rule shows in the rules dialog
/previsione-cassa via nav-previsione-cassa and via bank-panel-forecast ('Tra 90 giorni: 850,34 € · sotto zero dal 29/11/2026 →')

forecast-days-30/60/90/180 change the data (30d: in 0, out -184.83, end -184.83; 90d: in 1220, out -369.66, end 850.34, min -184.83); forecast-chart renders an area; forecast-scaduti-switch toggles (no overdue data, so no visible change)
forecast-row links go to /passive/{id} and /fatture/{id}; clicking one opens the passive invoice detail
With no accounts (account temporarily moved away, then restored): forecast-no-accounts note shows and the Dashboard bank-panel is hidden
Mobile 390: Riconciliazione page, MatchDialog and Previsione page have no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). Only RegoleDialog overflows inside the dialog.
action_items: Fix the RegoleDialog mobile overflow (add grid-cols-1 or min-w-0 on DialogContent / list wrapper)
Remove the duplicated 'regola X · regola "X"' label (backend note default or frontend suffix)
Optionally run /banca/auto after a rule is created from MatchDialog so similar pending movements reconcile right away, as the toast suggests
Improve the forecast YAxis tick formatting for small values
Warn when accounts with no saldo are counted as 0 in the forecast; fix singular/plural Italian strings
critical_code_review_comments: BankPanel always calls /banca/previsione even when there are no accounts (the result is not shown). This is a harmless extra request.

PrevisioneCassa useEffect has no stale-response guard. Quickly switching between the 30/60/90/180 chips could show data for a different chip than the one selected. Riconciliazione already uses a reqId guard; reuse that pattern.
PrevisioneCassa shows nothing while loading (d === null) and nothing on error except a toast. Add a loading state.
forecast-row anchors have no data-testid (the rows do).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 1 mobile layout bug in RegoleDialog)
